name: mint-is-a-buy
note: Ticket 08: firstBuyAt is the earliest incoming Transfer of non-zero value, whatever the source, and a mint Transfer(0x0, a, v) is one. Alice is minted 100 and Bob buys 100 from the funder, both at 2,998,800, exactly 7 days before the window closes at 3,603,600, so both hold 1.25x: weights 1,250,000 each, W = 2,500,000, and 1000 splits 500 / 500. If a mint were not a buy, Alice would have no firstBuyAt: read as the 0 sentinel her streak is 41 days and 1.50x, W = 2,750,000 and the split is 545 / 454 with 1 in Carry; read as never having bought she is 1.00x, W = 2,250,000 and the split is 444 / 555 with 1 in Carry. On chain NUTZ has no mint function and its only mint is the launch supply to the curve, an Excluded address, so this Case pins what hermetic fixtures mean by a mint rather than a shape a Holder will see.
